title: The One After Vegas
line: Oh, thank God. )gets out of bed) Ohh, I mean, we were really drunk. I'm just glad we didn't do anything stupid.

line: (starting to move closer to him) That's right, I wanna do it with you! I've been trying to fight it, but you just said all the right things.

line: Yeah. Thought I'd give it a shot. I'm still on the first chapter. Now, do you think his 'love stick can be liberated from its denim prison'?

line: All right, you know what? This isn't funny anymore. There's something about me on that piece of paper and I want to see it.

line: See? Yeah, you told me the story. He and Monica dated when they broke up they couldn't even be in the same room together and you all promised that you would stay his friend and what happened? He got phased out!

line: Oh my God. I cannot keep having this same fight with you Ross! Look, urrgh, maybe we should take a break.

line: Oh, Joey, I'm sorry I just couldn't tell her all those things you wanted me to tell her. And you know we got to talking and I...

line: Terry, I, I, I know that I haven't worked here very long, but I was wondering, do you think it would be possible if I got a $100 advance in my salary?

line: Oh, what are you going to do?! Are you gonna go run tell Monica?! Are you gonna tell Joey?! No! Because then you will have to tell them what we did! We are desert stealers! We are living outside the law!

title: The One Where No One Proposes
line: Yes, you did...Oh my God you didn't! (Screams) Well then why didn't you tell me that before?!

line: Oh, like I wasn't dreading tomorrow enough, having to give it back to him... 'Hi Barry! Remember me? I'm the girl in the veil who stomped on your heart in front of your entire family!' Oh God and now I'm gonna have to return the ring, without the ring, which makes it so much harder...

title: The One With The Rumor
line: (entering carrying a book) Okay! Okay! Listen to what Sean McMahon wrote in my yearbook senior year, "Dear Rach, you're such a good person." Not girl! Person!

title: The One Where Rachel Smokes

line: Hi! Sorry to bother you, but I don't think we can accept your acceptance of our apology, it just doesn't really seem like you mean it.

line: Oh, I know. I know. The odds are against us. But somebody has to win, and it could be us! And then how're you gonna feel? You know? I gotta gas up the Hyundai."

title: The One With The Blackout
line: I just never had a relationship with that kind of passion, you know, where you have to have somebody right there, in the middle of a theme park.

line: (really excited) Great!! It was very, very nice to meet you sir--Ow! Hey! What are you doing?! Are you crazy! (He took out that thing they use to look at people's retinas and looked at Rachel's when she was shaking his hand causing her to flinch and scream at him.)

title: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
line: Because, I feel like I wouldn't just be going out with him. I would be going out with all of you. Oh, and there would just be all this pressure, and I don't wanna...

line: Honey see, it doesn't mean that I don't love you. Because I do. I love you, I love you so much. But my work it's-it's for me you know, I'm out there, on my own, and I'm doing it and it's scary but I love it, because it's mine. I, but, I mean is that okay?

title: The One Where Chandler Takes a Bath
line: I'm not! We're having a girl! Sometimes I can't believe it's with you...But still! We're having a girl!

line: (entering) Oh-ho, my God! That was so awesome! You totally got him back for calling you fat! He was just drooling all over you. That must've felt so great!

title: Friends TV Show The One With Phoebe's Rats
line: Oh, you know what? My first impression of you was absolutely right. You are arrogant. You are pompous. Morgan! Morgan! Tag's last name was Morgan! Ha!

title: The One With Rachel's Sister
line: What handsome is not your type? Smart? Kind? Good kisser? What those things aren't on your list? Ross is a great guy! You would be lucky to be with him!

title: The One Where Ross Can't Flirt
line: Oh! You know what? You're right! We meet, you flirted and then BAM nine years later you had me!

title: The One After the Superbowl, Parts 1 and 2
line: Oh yeah. Well, at least I wasn't too chicken to tell some guy I thought he was cute. (Monica pulls a thread on Rachel's sweater and Rachel dumps the tomato sauce in Monica's purse)

line: Okay, now, Joey, listen. This is gonna be bridesmaid central, all right? We're gonna have hair and make-up going on in the bathroom and, oh, I had to move a couple of things in the fridge to make room for the corsages.

line: Okay, fine, you can make fun of me. I do not want Emma going there. And I was thinking Claire Danes.

title: The One With Rachel's Crush
line: Would you like to go to a basketball game with me? (Tries again.) You know, its funny, basketball, because I happen to have tickets too... (Tries again.) Umm, who likes the Knicks...(Joshua comes in from the dressing room.)

line: Oh, really? Well, Ross, you know what? I am a big girl. I don't need someone telling me what is best for me.

line: Okay, well you are just gonna have too, okay. Because I already got a Mother and a Father who cannot stay in the same room together, okay, I don't wanna have to have a separate room for you too!! (starts to cry)

title: The One With The Vows
line: Yes, I know! And Joey knows! But Ross doesn't know, so you have to stop screaming!

title: The One With The Secret Closet
line: It's not kicking right now. Although we would love to see you do (Mimics him) that again.

line: I'm not jealous. All right this is about, umm, people feeling certain things you know about strippers. And you know, and um, I...

title: The One Hundredth
line: Honey, you know I just gotta tell you, I think this is such a terrific thing you're having these babies for Frank and Alice.

title: The One With the Invitation
line: ...the way you owned up to everything, it just showed me how much you've grown. You know? I mean my Mom never thought this would work out. It was all, "Once a cheater, always a cheater." Ooh, I just wish we hadn't lost those four months, but if time was what you needed just to gain a little perspective... Ross: WE WERE ON A BREAK!!

line: Yeah. I mean, it was the weirdest thing. They fire me and then out of nowhere, they just hire me back! I mean, that place must just be falling apart without me.

line: Oh yeah, it's fine, it's fine. Sandy was just... was just telling me about how he proposed to his fianc�e and it was just sooo beautiful.

line: Alright, fine. You can keep it. As long as you don't mind that she's haunted.

title: The One With Ross's Teeth
line: Well, sure, but they might think it's kinda weird considering I don't work there anymore.

title: The One With A Chick. And A Duck
line: Now that you're on you're own, you're free to look as stupid as you like.

line: Yeah, when I was in the bathroom I saw the window that I crawled out of at my wedding, and God, I just started thinking that I shouldn't be here, you know I shouldn't, people are going to be looking at me and judging me and, and thinking about the last time.

title: The One With Joey's New Brain
line: Okay, no way. You cannot use that to get the cute guy and the last blueberry muffin.

title: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
line: No! None! I mean, my first night in the city, he mentioned something about asking me out, but nothing ever happened, so I just... (to Joey): W-well, what else did he say? I mean, does he, like, want to go out with me?

title: The One With the Evil Orthodontist
line: Right,.. well,.. we never actually got to that... Oh, it was just so nice to see him again, you know? It was comfortable, it was familiar... it was just nice!

title: The One Where Rachel Has A Baby, Parts 1 and 2
line: Doctor you gotta do something! I think you gotta give me drugs or you gotta light a fire up in there and just smoke it out.

line: Everybody? Shh, shhh. Uhhh... Central Perk is proud to present the music of Miss Phoebe Buffay.

line: I don't care! I don't care! You are going to have to take her out again and end it, and end it in way that she knows it's actually ended. And, I don't care how hard it is for you, do not tell her that you will call her again!

line: (tearful) I just can't believe this! I mean, with the holidays coming up- I wanted him to meet my family-

line: I don't know, you know? I feel a little umm... No, you know what? Nevermind, I'm gonna be fine.
